paragraphs.text: Adamaro (AH-dah-MAH-roh; ada あだ "enmity," "harm," "jealousy," or "covetous" + maro まろ male suffix) , First to Desire , is a kami on Kamigawa that was once a human.
Adamaro is the feared kami of a famed human warrior who was consumed by his anger and envy. It has been said that pain and anger are perfected within him, and his very gaze brings destruction.
